findings.evidence: Diffractive/Basic.lean:77-90 and 117-123 reference only `K.delta`, `K.p`, `K.q`, `K.Q2`; `delta` is `K.pPrime - K.p` (Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:54-55) and `Q2`/`xBj` are `DisKinematics` defs (Kinematics/Basic.lean:52-57). `grep -n 'ExclKinematics'` over EpsilonEridani/ returns hits only in Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean and the new Diffractive/Basic.lean.
findings.fix: State them over `DisKinematics V`, which already carries `pPrime` (Kinematics/Basic.lean:35-37); with `ExclKinematics extends DisKinematics` they reach exclusive events for free via `toDisKinematics`, exactly as `xBj`/`Q2` now do. This requires moving `delta` (and with it `tMom`, since `t = Δ²` is also a function of `p`, `pPrime` only) to `DisKinematics`; `ExclKinematics.delta`/`tMom`/`xiSkew` have no uses outside Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean and the new file, so the move is contained. Keep `MX2`, `MX2_def` and `MX2_eq_q_sub_delta` on `ExclKinematics` — they genuinely need `qPrime` and `hMomentum`.
findings.issue: `xi` (l.77), `xi_def` (l.80), `beta` (l.86), `beta_def` (l.89) and `xBj_eq_xi_mul_beta` (l.117) are stated for `ExclKinematics V`, but their bodies mention only `K.delta` (= `pPrime - p`), `K.p`, `K.q` and `K.Q2` — all parent `DisKinematics` data. The `qPrime`, `phiL`, `phiH` fields and the `hMomentum` proof are unused assumptions: a caller holding an inclusive event with an identified `P'` must fabricate a produced system, two angles and a conservation proof to use `ξ`, `β` or `x = ξβ`. The roadmap itself records these as functions of `q`, `P`, `P'` alone (README §0.1, 'The y-independence of ξ, β and t: they are functions of q, P, P' alone').

summary: The diffractive variables `xi`, `beta` and the `x = ξβ` identity use only fields of the `DisKinematics` parent (`p`, `pPrime`, `q`), yet are stated over `ExclKinematics`, so they needlessly demand a produced system, two azimuthal angles and a momentum-conservation proof. `MX2` and `MX2_eq_q_sub_delta` are correctly placed, since they genuinely need `qPrime`/`hMomentum`.
